title: The channels opened. Panic did not.
dek: 15 October 2026 hourly wick to $79,676, the daily box since 1 October, and Farside ETF flows through the −$825M nine-session bleed.
thesis: The $86k upgrade failed. $82k is a membrane. $80k was tagged and not kept. Early transmission in vol, oil and Nasdaq desynchronized into Friday.
stakes: Next evidence is whether $82k holds as a close — or whether $80k is accepted. Panic is not the base case until the channels travel together.
subscribeHook: A close through $80k — or two weekday closes back above $86k — updates the sequence. Charts stay free here; the call moves by email.
sourceNote: Issue 30 charts use Coinbase Exchange UTC candles (hourly 15 Oct 2026; daily 1–15 Oct) and Farside Investors US-session ETF flows. 16 October is a partial UTC day and an incomplete Farside row. Weekend blanks are not zeroes. Educational scenario research; no leverage.

briefs.headline: The wick found $80k. The close did not stay there.
briefs.lede: The 13:00 UTC hour lowed $79,676. The next hour closed $81,780. The UTC day closed $82,131.
briefs.bodyHtml:
Fact. $80k tagged around the US PPI window. Daily close back above $82k on 7,047 BTC.

Read. Tagging is not acceptance. One absorbed pulse is not a panic.

briefs.headline: One close above $86k. Then a membrane at $82k.
briefs.lede: 4 October closed $86,507. 8, 12 and 14 October closed below $82k and were reclaimed. 15 October lowed $79,676.
briefs.bodyHtml:
Fact. Issue 29's second-close upgrade never printed. $82k is no longer a clean daily hold.

Read. The floor became a membrane. $80k has been seen and not kept.

briefs.headline: The bid did not only blink
briefs.lede: 5–15 October completed Farside rows net about −$825M. 7 October printed −$484.9M.
briefs.bodyHtml:
Fact. 16 October is incomplete and is not a zero. Weekend blanks are not zeroes.

Read. Creations are not confirming a Model A advance.
